name: mexxi
job: The whole workflow: it leads the coding agent you already use from a request to a pull request that proves its own work.

name: ibni
job: The command-line tool the agent runs to give each task its own copy of the repository, and to push only the exact code recorded as passing its checks.

name: wettaq
job: Takes a request in plain words to one tested, reviewed pull request.

name: lesti
job: Opens one pull request that gets a repository ready for mexxi.

name: ittestja
job: Tries a page or flow in a real browser and reports what is broken, without changing code.

name: fassal
job: Writes a product's UX principles, so agents make interface decisions the way you would.

name: sewwi
job: Audits or changes the workflow itself: its commands, skills, agents and rules.

name: irrifletti
job: Looks back at your recent agent sessions, privately, to show whether a change to the workflow helped.

name: ibda
job: The setup skill a pasted prompt points to: it installs, repairs or upgrades mexxi.
